summary: Iteration 70 - News Extensions (scheduled publish, owner/channels, governance) + Quick Wins (cleanup cron, soft-delete, restore, participant_count): All 19 backend tests passed (100%). Frontend tests verified NewsEditorDialog channel toggles (intranet/email/push/digital_signage), SeriesManagerDialog with cancel-occ/restore-occ buttons, series badges showing 'Serie X/Y' format.
critical_code_review_comments: NEWS: POST /api/news/posts correctly coerces status='scheduled' when publish_at is in the future, even if 'published' was requested
NEWS: Response includes owner_id, owner_name, and channels fields. Default channels=['intranet']
NEWS: PATCH /api/news/posts/{id}/owner transfers ownership and creates 'owner_transferred' audit log entry
NEWS: GET /api/news/posts/{id}/governance returns post info (owner, channels, status) and history (audit entries)
NEWS: PUT /api/news/posts/{id} with future publish_at coerces status to 'scheduled'
MAINTENANCE: Background task starts on server startup (verified 'Maintenance background task started' in logs)
MAINTENANCE: POST /api/admin/maintenance/cleanup returns counts for news_posts, schedule_polls, surveys, meetings with TEST_* prefix cleanup
MEETINGS: DELETE /api/meetings/{id}?soft=true on series occurrence sets status='cancelled' with cancelled_at and cancelled_by fields
MEETINGS: DELETE /api/meetings/{id}?soft=true on non-series meeting performs hard delete (no series_id = no soft behavior)
MEETINGS: POST /api/meetings/{id}/restore reverts cancelled -> scheduled, returns 400 if not cancelled
MEETINGS: POST /api/meetings with meeting_type='instant' returns participant_count=1, scheduled returns participant_count=0
seed_data_creation: Test data created during tests was cleaned up via /api/admin/maintenance/cleanup
context_for_next_testing_agent: Iteration 70 tested: (1) NEWS scheduled publish - POST with future publish_at coerces status='scheduled' even if 'published' requested. Past publish_at allows 'published'. (2) NEWS owner/channels - Response includes owner_id, owner_name, channels (default=['intranet']). Custom channels accepted. (3) NEWS owner transfer - PATCH /posts/{id}/owner transfers owner, creates 'owner_transferred' audit entry. (4) NEWS governance - GET /posts/{id}/governance returns post info + history. (5) NEWS update coercion - PUT with future publish_at coerces status='scheduled'. (6) MAINTENANCE cleanup - POST /admin/maintenance/cleanup returns counts, admin-only (403 for non-admin). (7) MAINTENANCE background task - Verified 'Maintenance background task started' in logs. (8) MEETINGS soft-delete - DELETE ?soft=true on series occurrence sets status='cancelled' with timestamps. Non-series meetings hard-delete. (9) MEETINGS restore - POST /meetings/{id}/restore reverts cancelled->scheduled, 400 if not cancelled. (10) MEETINGS participant_count - instant=1, scheduled=0. (11) FRONTEND NewsEditorDialog - channel toggles (data-testid='channel-intranet/email/push/digital_signage') all present, intranet selected by default. (12) FRONTEND SeriesManagerDialog - occurrence rows, cancel-occ buttons, series-ical-btn, delete-series-btn, apply-bulk-btn, scope radios all present. Series badges show 'Serie X/Y' format.
